title: Yellowed Dense British Beef Yorkshire Pudding
description: A traditional British dish featuring a dense and fatty Yorkshire pudding made with 00-flour, served with beef, this recipe is Whole30-friendly and kid-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the 00-flour, eggs, whole milk, salt, and black pepper until smooth.
Heat the beef drippings in a kadhai over medium heat.
Pour the batter into the kadhai and cook for 2 minutes.
Transfer the kadhai to the preheated oven and cook for 20 minutes, or until the pudding is golden brown and puffed.
Remove the pudding from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the pudding with the cooked and diced beef.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
